Closure of Eastbound W Dayton Street between N Charter and N Mills Streets

posted  October 19, 2026 – 10:52am

Starting on Monday, October 26, Terra Construction will close eastbound traffic along W Dayton Street, between N Charter Street and N Mills Street to conduct work on the UW-Madison chilled water system. Westbound traffic will remain open. This closure will remain in place until approximately March 2027.
